Projects.title: System Deployments
Projects.meta_description: Detailed review of large-scale aviation and loyalty systems engineered with Next.js, Typia, and distributed caching.

items.title: Cathay: Global Booking Engine
items.description: Next-gen airline booking platform built for high reliability and rapid scaling.
items.desc:
• Organizational Scaling: Orchestrated the scaling of a 4-man squad into a 20-member organization across 4 functional workstreams.
  • Runtime Integrity: Integrated Typia for runtime schema validation, reinforcing system stability by eliminating runtime type-mismatch errors from external APIs.
  • Observability: Implemented structural logging (IP/Trace ID/Span ID) and NanoID for production incident tracing via ELK.
  • Engineering Standard: Enforced Atomic Design with isolation testing via Storybook and comprehensive Vitest suites.

items.title: HK Express: Static & Booking Modernization
items.description: High-velocity airline content hub with Sitecore Cloud SaaS integration.
items.desc:
• Pioneer Integration: Led the first Sitecore Cloud SaaS + Next.js integration at Accenture HK.
  • Edge Performance: Optimized performance via Akamai Cache Control for both static HTML and React Server Components (RSC).
  • System Resilience: Utilized Redis for multi-pod container state persistence and ISR caching to support real-time content previews.

items.title: HK Express: Booking System Rebuild
items.description: Modernizing airline booking flow and static pages with Next.js 14.
items.desc:
• Technical Foundation: Defined the core Next.js structure, build configurations, and folder standards for the entire booking ecosystem.
  • Developer Experience: Established frontend practices that streamlined development for multi-squad delivery.
  • Hybrid Rendering: Implemented optimized mix of ISR and SSR to balance static performance with dynamic booking sessions.

items.title: Cathay: Membership Ecosystem
items.description: Modernizing legacy loyalty infrastructure with Secure 2FA and React.
items.desc:
• Modernization: Led the UI rebuild from legacy React versions and implemented secure 2FA flows for global loyalty members.
  • Delivery Mgmt: Directed delivery for offshore teams, ensuring code quality through rigorous reviews and adherence to standards.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Acted as the primary technical interface for C-suite clients to manage expectations and provide solutions.

items.title: AXA Emma Mobile
items.desc:
• Feature Delivery: Contributed to the cross-platform development of the Emma mobile application.
  • Reliability: Focused on stable component architecture and feature parity across iOS and Android environments.
